interpretation.text:
There is insufficient statistical evidence that GNN-based representations change QoS relative to the DRL-PSO baseline in the tested regime.
    GNN_DRL_PSO : mean=0.5927 std=0.0090
    DRL_PSO     : mean=0.5912 std=0.0072
    Δ mean = +0.0015  (+0.26%)
    Paired evaluation across 5 seeds gave a mean difference of +0.0015 (+0.26%). Wilcoxon p-value = 1.0000. Cohen's d = 0.216. GNN produced a small non-significant improvement — this may reflect improved convergence or generalization that a larger training budget or more seeds could confirm. GNN adds an average of -0.0024s of DRL inference per episode (0.0145s vs 0.0169s). Note: p > 0.05 does NOT prove the methods are equivalent — it means the current experimental budget does not provide sufficient evidence of a statistically significant difference.
